topic: This with an integrated relative after a name
claim: In Who’s [this Penelope who’s been sending you emails]?, this is an embellishment of the proper name.
evidence_summary: Ch. 12, p. 1062: with an integrated relative the name is “a nominal, not an NP”, and the larger nominal “is not a proper name and hence … it requires a determiner”. §20.4(a) [6i] treats The Mary that you met yesterday as a secondary use.
finding: Replace the example (That Senator Fox in the same display has no relative) or reclassify it as a secondary use.
inference: Is this an embellishment when the name has an integrated relative?

evidence.establishes: The example meets Ch. 12’s description of a required determiner.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
